summary: Archon M+ re-cut: 20 tier moves, 8 consensus cells (all M+, one band). Murlok + Mythicstats S2 re-bases merged. Aug-19 hotfix logged. SimC MID2 appeared, not adopted.

sources.detail: All 6 live pages re-fetched by direct browser-UA GET, HTTP 200, 192-340 KB, parsed from <table class="tier-list"> rows (first <td> = the tier letter; each tier-list-entry's FIRST img alt looked up WHOLE against the roster, never split positionally, which is what keeps the six two-word-class specs matchable): raid 27/7/6 + M+ 27/7/6 = 80 assignments, 0 unmatched, and the per-page counts were printed and reconciled against the 27+7+6 roster shape before merging. ZERO tier moves against stored, raid and M+ alike - consistent with the page dates, which are byte-identical to last night's (raid DPS 2026-08-16, raid healer 08-13, raid tank 08-08, M+ DPS/healer/tank all 08-16) and agree 6/6 with published-evidence/evidence.json, so nothing upstream rebuilt in the last 24h. Era read from each page's own title AND body, never a substring count: five titles self-identify as Patch 12.1 / Season 2, and the raid-HEALER page again carries a "Patch 12.0.7 / Midnight" title over a Season-2 body (21 Season-2 mentions against 6 Season-1) - body over title, per the blue-tracker precedent. seasonVerified stays s2 on all six; no seasonVerified value changed for this source, so it contributes nothing for freeze-season.mjs to do. published re-read per page and NOT carried forward; unchanged. Snapshots 2026-08-19 -> 2026-08-20.

Both pages re-fetched live, HTTP 200, 158/161 KB, parsed from the .tier__tier blocks (tier__title = the letter, img alt = "Spec Class"): 40 raid + 40 M+ rows, 0 unmatched, no duplicate spec+bracket, ZERO tier moves. The M+ page again carries 8 tier blocks rather than 4 - the extra set is the dungeon-difficulty list, rejected by ROSTER MATCH (9 non-roster labels, the eight Season-2 dungeon names plus the Method logo, failed to map) and never by position. Era from each page's own BODY: raid "how each spec ranks for Raiding content in the Midnight Season 2 Raid, The Venomous Abyss" (Last Updated 10th August 2026), M+ "how different specs rank ... in Midnight Season 2" with Tactyks' byline naming Season 2 (Last Updated 13th August 2026). STILL WORTH KNOWING: the pages' <meta description> boilerplate reads "The War Within Season 3" on both - stale site chrome contradicting the rendered body, so an era check reading the meta tag would wrongly drop both pages from the consensus. seasonVerified stays s2 on both; nothing to freeze. Method carries no published field by convention and none was invented. Snapshots 2026-08-19 -> 2026-08-20.

All 6 pages re-fetched with the FULL browser header set (a UA-only request is Cloudflare-403; r.jina.ai stays untried, it is IP-403 on /guide/* since 2026-08-03), HTTP 200, 73-337 KB. Parsed by unescaping \/ -> / across the whole document FIRST and then finding [tier-list=rows] ... [/tier-list] - never by anchoring on WH.markup.printHtml(, since the raid-healer page carries a decoy call - with tolerant whitespace on [tier-label ...]X [/tier-label] and the [spec-badge=<spec>-<class>] kebab slug as the identifier: 27/7/6 raid + 27/7/6 M+ = 80 rows, 0 unmatched, exactly one tier-list block per page. ZERO tier moves. Era: all six titles and their in-body headings read "for Midnight Season 2"; seasonVerified stays s2, nothing to freeze. published re-read per page and NOT carried forward: raid DPS 2026-08-14, raid healer 2026-08-18, raid tank 2026-08-14, M+ DPS/healer/tank all 2026-08-18 - every one unchanged from stored and agreeing 6/6 with published-evidence/evidence.json. Snapshots 2026-08-19 -> 2026-08-20.

The two brackets remain in different states, and the M+ side moved hard. All 6 aggregate pages re-fetched, HTTP 200, 48-92 KB, parsed from <script id="__NEXT_DATA__"> at props.pageProps.page.specTierListSection.tierLists, taking metric "score" for M+ (never the default popularity grouping) and resolving every entry from its icon "Class-Spec" token with tiers[].entries read as a list OF LISTS. M+: 40/40 letters merged with 20 TIER MOVES - Assassination Rogue B->S, Fire Mage C->A, Discipline Priest A->C, Feral Druid and Outlaw Rogue A->S, Guardian Druid and Shadow Priest S->A among them. This is a genuine week-two re-cut, not a parse artifact: the M+ parse pool has nearly quadrupled overnight (88,280 + 29,405 + 29,435 last night -> 332,239 + 110,677 + 110,727 tonight), 0 rows were unmatched, and the letter set is unchanged at S/A/B/C. Checked against the anomaly limits BEFORE finishing: it lands as 8 consensus moves, all M+, all one band, 0 two-band, 0 vanished - against maxTotalMoves 25 and maxTwoBandMoves 6, so no ack is needed and none is proposed. RAID: those three pages describe Season 2 (title "Midnight DPS/Healer/Tank Rankings and Raid Tier List", the 9 Season-2 bosses in the selector) but publish NOTHING - totalParses 0 and all three tierLists (popularity/throughput/survivability) empty - two days into Mythic Venomous Abyss. Their seasonVerified was again left at s1 DELIBERATELY, the same judgement as 2026-08-19 and for the same reason: the field gates whether the STORED letters feed the live-season consensus, the stored Archon raid letters are still the Season-1 cut, and flipping them to s2 would average S1 opinion into the S2 raid consensus. Nulling those 40 letters instead was rejected because it breaches the archon-tiers row floor (80 -> 40 against min 60) and the 25% row-drop guard, neither of which has an agent-side ack path. OWNER FLAG (repeat of 08-19): when Archon's raid tier list populates, re-verify those three pages to s2 in the SAME run that merges the new letters. Partial for the raid half only. Note the whole-source consequence is now the intended one: with the 2026-08-19 ancillary:true change, Archon's M+ bracket is judged on its three aggregate pages alone, so Archon IS in the M+ consensus (4 sources) and out of the raid consensus (3 sources). Snapshots on the 6 aggregate pages 2026-08-19 -> 2026-08-20; the 3 labelled pages left at 2026-08-18 because nothing landed from them.

NOT REFRESHED, and the stored data was deliberately left byte-identical (619 tier rows across 9 Season-1 bosses + 8 Season-1 dungeons, asOf 2026-08-17, top-level season stamp "s1"). Re-probed rather than assumed from last night: (1) both registered per-encounter URLs (.../raid/mythic/imperator and .../mythic-plus/10/windrunner-spire/this-week) still return HTTP 200 with NO page object in __NEXT_DATA__ - a 199,339-byte generic shell - so every stored encounter name remains dead upstream; (2) a Season-2 M+ dungeon page (altar-of-fangs) returns a healthy 27-row DPS score tier list with 33,104 parses, while a Season-2 raid boss page (nekzali-the-soulcaller) returns the same page-less shell; (3) a full S2 rewrite is therefore still structurally blocked and was not attempted - 8 dungeons x 40 specs = at most 320 tier rows with the raid side contributing zero, below the archon-encounters row floor of 440 AND a 48% drop against the committed 619, breaching maxRowDropPct 0.25. Both are hard publish-gate errors with no agent-writable ack channel, so the honest move is to leave the S1 file standing and say so. It misleads nobody: the file's season stamp is s1, liveSeason is s2, and the UI hides the whole Fight selector on exactly that mismatch. OWNER DECISION STILL NEEDED: rebuilding this lane for Season 2 needs a reviewed change to the archon-encounters floor in required-sources.json (a CODEOWNERS file) - either lower it to a dungeons-only reality of ~320, or wait until Venomous Abyss accumulates enough parses that Archon publishes per-boss tiers. Until then this row stays partial and the page snapshot stays 2026-08-18, so the 10-day staleness gate will make the lag visible on its own.

The survivability read comes from the metric:"survivability" tierList on the three RAID aggregate pages, and those pages returned it EMPTY again tonight (0 entries) alongside throughput and popularity - the Season-2 raid state described in the archon-tiers row, totalParses 0. Nothing to merge, so the 40 stored survivability tiers are unchanged at their 2026-08-17 asOf and the labelled page snapshot was deliberately not bumped to today: bumping it would restart a 10-day staleness clock on data that did not refresh, and letting that gate fire around 2026-08-28 is the true signal if Archon's raid cut stays empty. The 2026-08-18 re-cut (Blood DK / Brewmaster / Vengeance B->A, Protection Paladin C->A) remains the last real state of this series and is what is published.

"95th pct DPS (Mythic)" could not be refreshed: props.pageProps.page.specRankingsSection.table.data is EMPTY on all three Season-2 raid pages (0 rows, totalParses 0), which is the same rebuild-with-no-data state as the raid tier lists rather than a parse failure - the recipe was proven on the same run against the M+ pages, where the identical path returned 27/7/6 rows with score, popularity and parses. The 33 stored rows (27 DPS + 6 tank) are byte-identical and keep their 2026-08-16 asOf; nothing was restamped with today. This series returns only when Mythic Venomous Abyss logging accumulates, and it will then be Season-2 raid DPS replacing Season-1 raid DPS under the same season-agnostic metric name - worth a value-move check on the night it lands.

"95th pct HPS (Mythic)" is in exactly the same state as archon-metrics and is reported separately rather than coupled to it, per the split-row rule: the Season-2 raid healer page's specRankingsSection carries 0 rows (totalParses 0), so none of the 7 stored HPS values could be refreshed. All 7 unchanged at 2026-08-16, nothing merged, no date restamped.

"M+ score (95th pct)" refreshed in full from the three Season-2 M+ pages' specRankingsSection.table.data[] - NOT the tierList structure, which carries only letters: 27 + 7 + 6 = 40/40 rows, 0 unmatched, floats rounded to the stored integer precision (read off specs.json, not assumed), each row's `parses` carried through as n (332,239 / 110,677 / 110,727 across the three cuts, up ~3.8x on last night as Season-2 keys fill in). Movement is mild now that the re-base has happened: family median 2709 -> 2730, +0.8%, well inside maxFamilyMedianMovePct 0.35, and no row anywhere near maxValueMovePct 0.6 - checked BEFORE merging. asOf is Archon's own lastUpdated 2026-08-19T12:00:00Z, never the run date.

Half the series refreshed and half could not, so the requirement's coverage date correctly does not move. The 40 M+ rows were re-parsed from the Season-2 pages and merged at Archon's own 2026-08-19, shape-checked BEFORE the merge exactly as the recipe requires: every value a plausible percentage (0.3-42.5), the three M+ role groups summing to 99.9 / 99.9 / 100.1, and no row equal to that spec's own 95th-pct DPS (0 clashes) - the check that catches the DPS-column-under-a-%-unit failure. Stored precision is 1 dp and was matched. The 40 RAID rows could not be refreshed at all, because the Season-2 raid pages publish an empty specRankingsSection (see archon-metrics), so they stay untouched at 2026-08-16 - which is why the coverage date reads 2026-08-16 and why this row is partial rather than success. The M+ moves are large in relative terms on small numbers (worst: Affliction 1.3 -> 0.9) but every value sits far below the guard's 100-magnitude floor, so the value-move gate does not - and should not - see them.

Both JSON API endpoints fetched with plain curl, no headers/proxy/auth (the wowmeta.com HTML is a stale S3 prerender and was not touched). manifest.json snapshotDate 2026-08-11 and rankings/midnight/mplus/all/0.json carrying Last-Modified: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 15:25:05 GMT - the two agree, so unlike the 08-04 case there is no movement hidden behind a pinned manifest; the rankings file was DIFFED rather than trusted to the manifest date. Selected by WHITELIST (categoryType in {dps,hps,tank} + sortField === "lowerBound" + keyRange === undefined, never a "not dungeon" blacklist, because melee/ranged are SUBSETS of dps and would double-count 27 specs) = 27+7+6 = 40 rows, 40/40 name-matched with no mapping table. All 40 lowerBound values and numberOfCharacters counts identical to stored at the stored 1-dp precision. Nothing merged; asOf stays the SOURCE's snapshotDate 2026-08-11, never today. Upstream has now not run a pipeline for 9 days - it last ran the day 12.1 shipped - so this is one day past the contract's 8-day threshold and the heartbeat reds on it tonight. That red is accurate.

No WCL fetch by this agent: it holds no credentials and did not touch warcraftlogs.com by any transport, API or HTML. Read from wcl-fetch/evidence.json (attemptedAt 2026-08-20T11:00:22.147Z, this run) which reports verdict "rdps-broken" - OAuth and GraphQL are healthy (3600 points/hour, 1 spent) but characterRankings(metric: rdps) on encounter 3176 returns a bare "Internal server error", so the whole redistributed-credit metric family is still broken upstream; separately the HTML statistics transport has been Cloudflare-challenged since 2026-08-10 from residential IPs too, and the two are independent facts. evidence.landed is empty and carries no entry for wcl-live-raid, so the zone-53 (The Venomous Abyss, Mythic) medians could not land and the 47 stored rows are unchanged at 2026-08-10. This is the OWNER-ACCEPTED STANDING RED recorded in the requirement's own label: no S2 fetch path exists, the staleness alarm firing at 10 days IS the intended signal, and it clears when a zone-53 recipe lands in src/fetch-wcl.mjs - not by acking it away.

No WCL fetch by this agent (no credentials; warcraftlogs.com was not contacted by any means). Same evidence file and same verdict as wcl-live-raid - "rdps-broken", attemptedAt 2026-08-20T11:00:22.147Z, transport healthy, metric family 500ing - and evidence.landed has no entry for wcl-live-mplus, so the zone-55 (Mythic+ Season 2) medians could not land and the 40 stored rows are unchanged at 2026-08-10. All 3 meta pages fetched by plain GET (r.jina.ai does not work on murlok), HTTP 200, 41-71 KB, 40/40 rows parsed from the meta-item blocks, 0 unmatched. MERGED: all 40 values moved upward, family median 2192 -> 2744.5 (+25.2% against maxFamilyMedianMovePct 0.35) with a worst single row of Fire Mage 1539 -> 2346 (52.4% against maxValueMovePct 0.6). Both were computed BEFORE merging and both sit inside the guards, so unlike the 08-19 Season-2 re-base this lands with no ack required. The shape is what a top-50 CEILING does in week two of a season as players push rating: no zeros anywhere, range 2346-2898, every spec rising rather than a subset. Pages self-identify "Mythic+ in Midnight Season 2". asOf is the pages' OWN published timestamp - they carry a datetime= attribute reading 2026-08-20T03:32Z - not the run date. Snapshots 2026-08-19 -> 2026-08-20.

All 27 DPS charts requested via talent_target_scaling/castingpatchwerk with 5 attempts each. 17 specs return real data and 10 still return the 76-byte {"status": "error"} body persistently (Havoc, Devourer, Balance, Feral, Augmentation, Devastation, Windwalker, Retribution, Arms, Fury) - that body was retried rather than treated as structural, per the Beast Mastery precedent. The roster is IDENTICAL to last night's 17: no progress upstream in 24h. Every one of the 17 carries simc_settings.tier "MID2" (read off each chart, never hard-coded - it moves each season) with chart timestamps of 2026-08-19, while the 26 stored profiles are MID1-era. MERGED NOTHING, per the sim-tier uniformity gate: MID2 runs a mean 1.79x MID1 and fightLabels pools every DPS profile with no provenance key, so a 17-of-27 merge would publish WHICH specs have been re-simmed as if it were spec strength. Adopt a new tier wholesale or not at all. simc_settings.ptr was compared explicitly against the STRING "0". fightProfile.asOf therefore stays at the CHARTS' own 2026-07-08 / 07-15 - 43 days stale - and the heartbeat stays red, which is the true signal that upstream has not finished re-simming. FOR THE OWNER: when the last 10 specs land, the wholesale adoption will itself need a value_move_ack, since MID2-vs-MID1 moves most sim rows well past the 60% per-row limit.

NEW UPSTREAM FACT that changes nothing tonight: MID2_Raid.txt and MID2_Raid.html now EXIST (993 KB / 26.7 MB) where both 404'd last night. NOT adopted, for two independent reasons each verified rather than assumed - (a) the MID2 header self-identifies 12.1.0.69382 PTR while MID1's reads Live, and (b) its "DPS Ranking:" block is a PARTIAL run of 32 profiles covering roughly half the DPS roster (no Druid, Evoker, Monk, Warrior, Havoc/Devourer, Retribution), which is the same "which specs got re-simmed" trap the Bloodmallet tier gate exists to stop, and the stored metric name "SimC nightly Patchwerk DPS" is season-agnostic so a partial swap would publish silently. OWNER DECISION: adopting MID2 is a source-definition change (the registry page is MID1_Raid.html) and should wait for a complete, Live-flagged MID2 run. Meanwhile the standing recipe ran: MID1_Raid.txt is a 272-byte LIVE IN-PROGRESS run with no ranking block (header 1210-01, 12.1.0.69382 Live, git build HEAD 3e75e1b590, moved again from last night's b4248732a8), so it fell back to MID1_Raid.html - which is UNCHANGED at SimulationCraft 1205-01, 12.0.7.68974 Live, own timestamp 2026-08-08 07:28:33 - and re-parsed it anyway by taking the "data":[...] array enclosing the FIRST big-value MID1_ hit (a fixed byte window after "series" reads the later burst/DTPS charts at 2.2-2.5x inflation) and mapping profile names by LONGEST-PREFIX with a hyphen allowed: 49 profiles -> 26 DPS specs, all 26 byte-identical to stored; the 9 unmapped names are tank profiles, excluded by design. Nothing merged - an unchanged build is the honest explanation for an unchanged parse. At 12 days the contract's 10-day gate is already firing on this, correctly.

https://mythicstats.com/period/latest fetched server-rendered (r.jina.ai is Cloudflare-403 on this host), 302 -> /period/1077, HTTP 200: the SAME period as last night, but no longer half-filled. The page now reads "Top 2000 keys, 10000 characters (5914 unique), 12.1 average key level" where last night it read "Top 999 keys, 4994 characters" - so the stored series name "Top-2000 keys representation" is finally accurate rather than aspirational, and last night's honest caveat is retired. Parse bounded to the "Spec representation in top keys" section (scanning the whole page yields 59 rows from the Classes-and-specs and per-dungeon blocks) with lowercase-hyphenated labels normalised on [-\s]+: 40 rows, 0 unmatched. Verified it is the representation SHARE and not the /meta per-key-PRESENCE column before merging - series sum 100.1%, role subtotals 30.7 / 29.3 / 20.0 / 20.0, max row 10.1, no zeros. 38 of 40 values moved as the key pool doubled (Restoration Shaman 5.6 -> 8.2, Discipline Priest 2.5 -> 1.0); every value is far below the guard's 100-magnitude floor, so the value-move gate correctly does not see them. asOf 2026-08-20: the page publishes no date of its own and the period is live, so the run date is the honest stamp here (unlike wowmeta, murlok and bloodmallet, which do publish one).

Four channels swept, all healthy, one entry landed. (1) Wowhead news RSS parsed per <item> block: 40 items, newest 2026-08-20 02:09 CDT. (2) The news INDEX (data.news.newsData, brace-balanced from the id attribute) because it leads RSS within a run - it tops out at the same news=382535, so the two agree and nothing landed mid-run. (3) Blue tracker (data.blueTracker.default): 50 entries, newest 2026-08-19 22:15. (4) Dev-notes thread 2317811.json via curl for the full post_stream (WebFetch truncates to post 1): 17 posts, last_posted_at 2026-07-31, newest still Linxy #19 - the closed 12.1 cycle's expected quiet, not a lost thread. NO 12.2 PTR announcement in any channel. LOGGED: a kind:"hotfix" entry dated 2026-08-19, verified against the CANONICAL forum source rather than the mirror - Kaivax's running hotfix topic 2336376, whose title has rolled to "World of Warcraft: Midnight Hotfixes - August 19" and whose post 1 was edited 2026-08-20T03:14Z to append that section - and cited via wowheadUrl news=382535 because a hotfix has no post in the tracked thread. Read with heading structure INTACT off the cooked HTML <ul> nesting, which settled both attribution questions: Army of the Dead sits under the bare Death Knight heading (logged "Death Knight (class-wide)", so it reaches all three DK specs) while Dark Simulacrum / Cooldown Manager sits INSIDE the Unholy sub-list despite reading like a baseline line. The whole Classes section is bug fixes with no tuning value anywhere - Unholy DK, Restoration Druid, Marksmanship Hunter, Retribution Paladin, Restoration Shaman - so all 6 highlights classify null against classifyHighlight and NONE votes in the outlook tally, which is the honest reading of a bug-fix pass; no set bonus is touched, so no spec.tierSet was advanced and the tier-set upkeep gate stays quiet by fact rather than omission. specsAffected and highlights reconcile 6/6. Swept and correctly NOT logged, each checked: the post's own Delves / Dungeons and Raids / Items / Quests sections and its single PvP line; "Ula'tek Nerfed" and "Coiled Altar Massively Nerfed" (encounter tuning); "Hunter's Ritual Stone Weapon Embellishment Nerfed" (an ITEM name, not the class - the bare-token trap in item shape); "Venomcursed Items Secondary Stat Changes", "Blizzard Reverts Special Weapon Restrictions" and "Mythic+ Dungeon Tuning with Season 2 Launch"; and Kaivax's standalone blue post "Item Adjustment Incoming - August 25" (topic 2338382), fetched in full - it adjusts exactly one item and carries no class line. Writeup lane recomputed rather than quoted: 1 spec at ptr:null (Demonology Warlock, the deliberate null), and expertRead still returns null for all 40 specs in both brackets by construction, since it gates on PHASES.ptr and the 12.1 PTR phase ended at the flip.

Discovery complete, distillation impossible - 0 takes and 0 metaNotes added, no `latest` advanced. transcript-fetch/summary.json reports verdict "ok" with requested 0 / fetched 0, because data/pending-transcripts.json was EMPTY when the deterministic step ran (the 08-19 local run drained both of last night's queued videos into skipped[]), so no transcript existed to distil from. No transcript was fetched from YouTube or any API by this agent. 44 unique channel feeds polled with backoff (119 creator entries, 40 of them transcribable:false, share them), 44/44 HTTP 200, 660 entries diffed against a 1102-id seen-set built from the four STRUCTURED lanes (pending-transcripts seen[]/skipped[]/videos[] + every youtu.be id in a take or metaNote url), never a regex over log prose. 97 unseen, all 97 in-cycle against the 2026-06-18 bound (the OLDEST date in ptr-builds.json, taken as a date and not as builds[0]). TWO QUEUED under the nightly's keyword filter and the fetch-broadly/queue-narrowly rule that protects Supadata's 100-request MONTHLY budget, both chosen on their media:description rather than their title: Obli nmErWeN4woE "From S-tier to F-Tier... / Frost DK Update 12.1 Season 2", whose description is an explicit read ("Frost heavily overnerfed and now DKs are in the worst spot they've been in for years") squarely inside his Frost/Unholy DK scope; and Dorki 3r_vwmTUZXs "OFFICIAL SEASON 2 M+ TIER LIST", whose description carries his own chapter list (Intro / The List / Possible Comps / Revisions-Predictions), making it a 20-minute analysis rather than a clip - and Dorki is one of 14 transcribable creators the creator audit reports as having zero takes ever. NOTHING was retired to seen[]: no dismissal tonight is durable. The other 95 stay UNSEEN and were counted rather than estimated - 31 guide-shaped uploads (5 of them Tactyks' M+ content, separately firewalled since he writes the Method M+ list), 29 livestream/Twitch shells and RWF split streams that cannot carry captions yet, 10 raid-boss PoV clips, 8 PvP-framed uploads, 4 hashtag Shorts, and 11 others including NeekapHere's news round-up and izen's QoL to-do list, which is not a per-spec meta read. Two named judgement calls: Dratnos o3Ury9zK_1U (RWF Day 2) not queued because its Day-1 twin was transcript-verified and skipped on 08-19 for a structural reason that has not changed - a two-speaker co-cast the transcript never attributes - and Musguete MVZ2YaUC9Fo not queued despite a genuine strength claim in its description, because it is a hashtag Short whose sub-minute duration could not be VERIFIED. yt-dlp METADATA probe (no download, no captions) hit the datacenter bot wall on 3 of 3 videos - "Sign in to confirm you're not a bot", the settled 2026-07-17 finding - and was abandoned immediately rather than retried, so live_status and duration triage is unavailable on CI and stream-shells and Shorts can only be left unseen, never retired. npm run audit:creators is clean: HIGH 0, MED 0, INFO 15.
